title: Replay a comment in its original context

entries.caption: Highlight a passage to comment on

entries.text: Replay a comment in its original context

Every time someone posts, replies, resolves, or deletes a comment, markoto keeps a snapshot of that thread in the Activity log. Click the row in Activity and the drawer expands showing the thread the way it looked at that exact moment, parent, replies, resolution state, all preserved for as long as the doc lives.

entries.caption: The Activity feed opens, one row per edit, comment, restore.

entries.text: Click the comment row to replay it
Comment rows in the feed carry a chevron, click to expand. The thread appears inline, exactly as it was at that moment. No modal, no navigation; the editor stays in place.

entries.caption: The comment-context drawer expands, parent body, replies (none yet), resolution state. Anyone reviewing the audit can see this thread the way it looked then.

next.why: For posting + replying live (vs replaying past threads), the comments-thread flow is the canonical entry
